successful_shells.command:

import re,sys
D=sys.argv[1]
ids=["R-001","R-002","R-003","T-101","T-102","T-103"]
conc=re.compile(r"\d|`[^`]+`|\b(pytest|ValueError|Python|sys\.path|Drift|Regression|Grounding Gap|Authorized|Necessary|sonnet|grok|haiku|conftest|pyproject|f-string|None)\b")
vague=re.compile(r"\b(appropriate|as needed|properly|adequate|should consider|might|various|etc\.|best practices|industry standard|may|probably|about)\b",re.I)
for v in ["variant-1-original.md","variant-2-original.md"]:
    L=open(f"{D}/{v}").read().splitlines()
    print("==",v)
    print(" RC:",{i:sum(i in l for l in L) for i in ids})
    print(" H2:",[l for l in L if l.startswith("## ")])
    sub=[];infence=False
    for n,l in enumerate(L,1):
        s=l.strip()
        if s.startswith("```"): infence=not infence; continue
        if not s or s.startswith("#") or s.startswith("<!--") or re.match(r"^\|[-| ]+\|$",s): continue
        if re.match(r"^\*\*(Reviewer persona|Grounding root|Diff scope|Timestamp|Model|Model actually running)\*\*",s): continue
        if s.startswith("| #") or s.startswith("| id ") or s.startswith("| ID ") or s.startswith("| File ") or s.startswith("| Change #"): continue
        sub.append((n,s))
    c=[n for n,s in sub if conc.search(s)]
    vg=[n for n,s in sub if vague.search(s)]
    vonly=[n for n,s in sub if vague.search(s) and not conc.search(s)]
    print(" substantive:",len(sub)," concrete:",len(c)," vague-any:",len(vg),vg," vague-only:",vonly)
    print(" non-concrete lines:",[(n,s[:70]) for n,s in sub if not conc.search(s)])
    refs=re.findall(r"GG-\d|F-00\d|[Rr]ecommendation \d|Risks? #\d|see below",open(f"{D}/{v}").read())
    print(" refs:",refs)
EOF
